calculus-intuition-explain-zoom.skip: rubric-graded explanation; no deterministic grader, manually reviewed
calculus-intuition-explain-zoom.correct: At a smooth point, f'(a) is the tangent slope, obtained as the limit of secant slopes as h approaches zero. For small h, f(a+h) is approximately f(a)+f'(a)h; this is a local approximation, not a global identity.
calculus-intuition-explain-zoom.wrong: Zooming changes the function value, so the derivative is whatever height is visible.

calculus-intuition-explain-ftc.skip: rubric-graded explanation; no deterministic grader, manually reviewed
calculus-intuition-explain-ftc.correct: An increase dx adds a thin strip of area about r(x)dx to the accumulation, so dividing by dx and taking the limit gives A'(x)=r(x) when r is continuous.
calculus-intuition-explain-ftc.wrong: The derivative is always the accumulated area itself, so A'(x)=A(x).

	return (f(x + h) - f(x - h)) / (2 * h)

calculus-intuition-build.correct:
def volumes(initial, rates, dt):
	result = [initial]
	volume = initial
	for rate in rates:
		volume += rate * dt
		result.append(volume)
	return result
